scientific_integrity: Proof and exact finite-horizon identities are included; claims are limited to original-time ODEs and do not extend to fractional-order systems.
scientific_limitations: All long-time assertions assume an eventually compact orbit in the strictly positive octant; this is not proved for arbitrary parameters.
The supercritical variance law is a necessary restriction, not an existence result for a compact persistent orbit.
A 1988 primary paper could not be fully inspected, so historical priority remains conditional.
Finite rational checks and numerical integration do not replace the analytic proof.
title: Critical coexistence rigidity and an exact prey-fluctuation law in a three-species flow
